title: Preset groundwork in the shared crates/apricity-daw: file references, deterministic gzip, reference fixtures
description:
## Intent

Ground work for presets in the shared DAW crate. The crate itself is created by the sidecar initiative (apricitus-57dc3f) or the set export (apricitus-6f37e1), whichever lands first; this chore adds only what presets need, and must not create a second crate.

## Scope

- In `crates/apricity-daw` (after the skeleton exists): modules `rack` and `pads` declared; a `fileref` helper shared with the set export (absolute and relative path from the output file to the sample, as the M0 notes say the DAW reads them); deterministic gzip (fixed header time, stable attribute order) if the skeleton does not already guarantee byte-identical output.
- Copy M0's reference presets into `crates/apricity-daw/tests/fixtures/reference/` (XML only) if the spike left them elsewhere; reuse the shared tiny-WAV and manifest builders (apricitus-e0688b / apricitus-2831a6) in the runner instead of adding a third.
- Confirm the crate still builds for `wasm32-wasip1` (no audio dependencies), so the web app can call the writers later.

## Out of scope

Rack content (later tasks). A second runner: presets use the shared `tests/conformance.rs` over `features/daw/*.feature`.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo build -p apricity-daw --target wasm32-wasip1
```

## Release

`chore(<this task id>): preset groundwork in apricity-daw`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by M0 and by the crate skeleton (apricitus-57dc3f or apricitus-6f37e1).
